title: Папки
description: Голосом по домашней папке DuoWave (~/DuoWave): «какие у меня папки», «что в папке Фото», «открой папку Рецепты», «покажи фото из Отпуска», «прочитай файл борщ», «найди рецепт борща», «запиши в папку Рецепты блины два яйца», «что на флешке». В разговоре — «дальше», «предыдущая», «назад», «номер три», «прочитай», «оставь», «закрой», «пауза», «продолжи», «хватит». Фото и видео открываются окном на экране компьютера; большая карточка на столе показывает то же место. Имена файлов вслух — только своим голосом или с галочкой папки; облачной модели — только с галочкой.

en.title: Folders
en.description: Your DuoWave home folder (~/DuoWave) by voice: what folders there are, what is in a folder, open it, show photos, read a file, find, write a note, what is on a USB drive. In a conversation: next, previous, back, number three, read, keep, close, pause, go on, stop. Photos and videos open in a window on the computer’s screen.

tools.name: folder_find
tools.description: Search by name in the DuoWave home folder (photos, documents, a plugged-in drive). Returns files/… addresses: open with folder_open, read a document with folder_read.

query.description: Part of a file or folder name, in the person's words

folder.description: A files/home/… folder to search in; none — everywhere

tools.name: folder_open
tools.description: Open a home folder or file: its names and kinds. Photos, video and sound open in a temporary window on the computer's screen (the next one takes its place). No address — the list of folders.

tools.name: folder_show
tools.description: Show photos, video and sound from the home folder, each in its own window on the computer's screen. New windows replace temporary ones (kept ones stay). Returns the windows' ids for screen_keep, screen_close, screen_pause, screen_resume.

addresses.description: files/home/… addresses of photos, video or sound, up to 8

add.description: Open beside the windows open now, closing none

tools.name: folder_play
tools.description: Video or sound from the home folder in a window on the computer's screen: play an address, pause, resume, stop (closes the window). Without an address pause and resume act on all that plays, stop on temporary windows.

tools.name: folder_read
tools.description: A document's text from the home folder (txt, md, rtf, docx, pdf), part by part.

tools.name: folder_write
tools.description: Write a text file into a home folder; a taken name gets «… 2».
